## Professional Summary

Egyptian Product Manager based in Dubai with 8+ years building fintech products across the MENA region. Specializes in Banking as a Service (BaaS), card programs, money movement, and developer-facing products for embedded finance.

Currently leading product for Nym4Business (N4B) and Lynq at NymCard — white-label BaaS platforms used by financial institutions across MENA. Previously shipped Partners Portal 2.0 at Tamara (BNPL), launched a Save Now Buy Later product at Compound, and integrated 100+ global merchants onto Mondia Pay's carrier billing platform.

Uses AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Figma MCP) to prototype BaaS features, generate API specs, and ship faster. Built this interactive portfolio entirely with Claude Code.

## Core Competencies

- **BaaS Product:** Card issuance, corporate hierarchy, KYB/IDV onboarding (Onfido, PRM, WorldCheck), expense management, Visa Direct cross-border payments, RBAC/approval workflows, FX management, CBUAE compliance
- **Developer Products:** API design, developer portal UX, integration documentation, sandbox environments, API reference portals
- **Payment Operations:** Carrier billing, merchant integrations, API lifecycle management, onboarding at scale (100+ merchants)
- **Stakeholder Management:** Cross-functional squads, C-suite alignment, external merchant/partner relations
- **AI-Assisted Delivery:** Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Figma MCP for rapid prototyping and spec generation

## Work Experience

### NymCard (Jun 2025 – Present) — Product Manager, Corporate BaaS (Dubai, UAE)

Leading Nym4Business (N4B) and Lynq — white-label BaaS platforms for MENA financial institutions.

**N4B platform covers:**
- Multi-tier corporate hierarchy for enterprise card programs
- Card issuance and expense management
- KYB/IDV onboarding with Onfido, PRM, and WorldCheck integrations
- Visa Direct cross-border payments
- RBAC and approval workflows
- FX management and funds storage
- CBUAE compliance

**Lynq (getlynq.ae):** Direct-to-SME BaaS variant of the N4B platform.

### Compound (Mar 2025 – Dec 2025) — Product Lead & Consultant (Remote, Part-time)

Defined and launched Save Now, Buy Later (SNBL) product from scratch:
- Savings plans with eligibility rules and goal-based milestones
- Customer mobile application (iOS and Android)
- Embeddable checkout widget for merchant partners
- Admin backoffice portal for operations team
- API documentation for merchant and partner integrations

### Tamara (Oct 2022 – Jan 2025) — Integration Delivery Manager → Product Manager (Dubai, UAE)

**As Product Manager (Jan 2024 – Jan 2025):**
- Led Partners Portal 2.0: merchant-facing self-service portal
- Reduced merchant support queries by 30%
- Improved merchant satisfaction scores by 25%
- Delivered 15+ features across portal, reporting, and merchant tooling
- Built product tour using GuideSail (negotiated trigger-logic requirements and custom pricing tier directly with the developer)
- Self-initiated 57% reduction in portal email costs via Mailchimp pricing model fix and email authentication cleanup
- Managed cross-functional squad of engineers, designers, and data analysts

**As Integration Delivery Manager (Oct 2022 – Jan 2024):**
- Revamped API Developer Reference Portal: cut integration GTM time by 25%, enabled 100M+ SAR GMV
- Deployed e-commerce plugins for MENA merchants (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento)
- Technical consulting for enterprise merchant integrations (PSPs, marketplaces, direct merchants)
- Managed integration lifecycle from technical scoping to go-live

### Mondia Pay (Nov 2020 – Sep 2022) — Senior Integration Operations Engineer (Cairo, Egypt)

- Integrated 100+ global merchants onto carrier billing platform: Spotify, OSN, Tinder, Anghami, and others
- Rewrote API documentation for external developer audience
- Managed full payment lifecycle for integrations across MENA, Europe, and Africa
- Worked with mobile network operators (MNOs) in multiple countries

### Dell Technologies (Feb 2018 – Nov 2020) — Technical Support Engineer (Cairo, Egypt)

- Enterprise B2B technical support for servers, storage, and networking
- Built systems thinking and technical troubleshooting foundation
